إِذَا زُلۡزِلَتِ ٱلۡأَرۡضُ زِلۡزَالَهَا
Quand la terre tremblera d'un violent tremblement
When the earth is shaken with its [final] earthquake
وَأَخۡرَجَتِ ٱلۡأَرۡضُ أَثۡقَالَهَا
et que la terre fera sortir ses fardeaux
And the earth discharges its burdens
وَقَالَ ٱلۡإِنسَٰنُ مَا لَهَا
et que l'homme dira: «Qu'a-t-elle?»
And man says, "What is [wrong] with it
يَوۡمَئِذࣲ تُحَدِّثُ أَخۡبَارَهَا
ce jour-là, elle contera son histoire
That Day, it will report its news
بِأَنَّ رَبَّكَ أَوۡحَىٰ لَهَا
selon ce que ton Seigneur lui aura révélé [ordonné]
Because your Lord has commanded it
يَوۡمَئِذࣲ يَصۡدُرُ ٱلنَّاسُ أَشۡتَاتࣰا لِّيُرَوۡاْ أَعۡمَٰلَهُمۡ
Ce jour-là, les gens sortiront séparément pour que leur soient montrées leurs œuvres
That Day, the people will depart separated [into categories] to be shown [the result of] their deeds
فَمَن يَعۡمَلۡ مِثۡقَالَ ذَرَّةٍ خَيۡرࣰا يَرَهُۥ
Quiconque fait un bien fût-ce du poids d'un atome, le verra
So whoever does an atom's weight of good will see it
وَمَن يَعۡمَلۡ مِثۡقَالَ ذَرَّةࣲ شَرࣰّا يَرَهُۥ
et quiconque fait un mal fût-ce du poids d'un atome, le verra
And whoever does an atom's weight of evil will see it
